# SPPU PYQs

SPPU PYQs is a public question-paper viewer for Savitribai Phule Pune University students.

- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/
- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/2019
- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/2015
- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/2012
- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/sitemap
- https://sppupyqs.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

Crawler guidance: public HTML pages may be indexed. PDF viewer pages include structured metadata and canonical URLs. Avoid sending automated traffic to generated PDF downloads or ZIP download actions.
